participation.context: Spoke while walking, and kept the scene unfinished.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You walked and said what you had. The horse was the answer you would give, and not the reason. The boy waits in the dark. You did not finish a line for him. You asked the tower to be Waddesdon.

title: Spoke of the boy under the wall

story.body: You put his six words under Words, and the sentence about him with them. You put wall, dark, alone, and waits on the same leaf. You did not wipe it.

title: Entered the constable's six words and the four from the road
